sources.native_reconstruction: same-run float32 native CAMB transfer rescaled and squared using the frozen adiabatic formula
sources.camb_power_nodes: direct get_linear_matter_power_spectrum internal CAMB power nodes
sources.log_cubic: same-result cubic spline of ln(P) versus ln(k), evaluated at aligned native k
sources.linear_cubic: same-result cubic spline of P versus ln(k), evaluated at aligned native k
sources.power_nodes_log_linear: log-log linear resampling of direct CAMB nodes
sources.previous_frozen_log_linear: log-log linear resampling of the old 2500-point log-cubic output
sources.class_integral: CLASS integral pk.dat with default gauge-invariant comoving delta_m

methods.raw: log-log interpolation to the common grid, no smoothing
methods.smooth_0.05dex: Gaussian smoothing of ln(P) with sigma=0.05 dex before band integration
methods.smooth_0.10dex: Gaussian smoothing of ln(P) with sigma=0.10 dex before band integration

boundaries: The A/B comparison separates log versus linear cubic output construction on one result object.
The old second log-linear resampling stage remains a separate candidate; neither is silently called the solver answer.
CLASS and CAMB output gauges differ at low k; no explicit gauge transformation or gauge-invariant cross-code proof is added.
No likelihood, parameter search, joint BBN, nonlinear calculation, or model-family exclusion.
